name: Querido Diario API
tier_rationale: Open Knowledge Brasil, a civil-society non-profit running the open-source Querido Diario project (A8 community); P236 'Querido Diario (Open Knowledge Brasil) community' and P243 'Open Knowledge Brasil is recorded as community tier'.

reliability.justification: Indexes official municipal gazettes for part of Brazil's municipalities; an empty result means 'not found in covered gazettes', never 'no mentions' (P243).

gazettes.title: Querido Diario gazette search API (/gazettes, /cities)

terms.quote: 'open' = free use, internal business use included (public domain, CC0, CC BY, open government data, and permissive or copyleft licences whose obligations V3LUM meets by runtime download and attribution, A6)

gazettes.notes: Quote: binding council text (A1 decision, docs/COUNCIL_1.md). Class 'open' is the P243 chair-file class: official municipal gazettes indexed by Open Knowledge Brasil as open data (research C0554). /gazettes?querystring=&territory_ids=&published_since=&size=10&excerpt_size=500 and /cities; at most 10 excerpts per query (P243).

company.title: Querido Diario company info and partners (/company/info, /company/partners by CNPJ)

terms.quote: Sources at release (class open, legal_dpo): BrasilAPI and Minha Receita (MIT code, RFB open data; one shared parser), publica.cnpj.ws public API (only free source of state IE) and Querido Diario company/partners.

company.notes: Quote: binding council text (P236 cond 1). /company/info/{cnpj} and /company/partners/{cnpj} (research C0528); QSA data keeps masked CPFs (rule 4) and a CPF is never looked up (P236).

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G10-2, p2-G10-3: batches only extend it (querido_diario__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). P243 also uses the alias host api.queridodiario.ok.org.br (single batch p2-G10-3): it is added with a querido_diario__<suffix>.json extension, not a second provider. ~3 s per query and no published limit (research C0554/C0528: throttle <= 1 req/s, cache 24 h) -> min_interval 1 s and ttl 24 h, no quota block. Error-in-200 and 401/403/429 = could not verify, never cached (P243). Person names only for typed due-diligence seeds (P243).
